summary: NextNRG, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a Nov 2, 2026 Debt Exchange Agreement between the Company, its subsidiary NextNRG Holding Corp., and CEO/director/principal stockholder Michael D. Farkas; the transaction closed November 3, 2026. Farkas exchanged $7,000,000 of obligations—$3,629,924 note principal, $2,749,169 accrued interest, and $620,907 guarantee fees—for 7,000 newly designated Series D Convertible Voting Preferred shares at $1,000 stated value each, with no cash paid. Exchanged amounts and related liens and guaranties were cancelled; excluded obligations remain outstanding. This is a related-party balance-sheet recapitalization by an insider, not a third-party special situation; watch Series C protective provisions limiting cash repayment of remaining insider debt and potential dilution from preferred conversion.
